ratification_blocked_by: GOVERNANCE.md (DEC-0007, L39): thresholds require empirical physiological validation; synthetic PASS is not empirical validation.
tools/validate_repository.py (L72-73): enforces success_thresholds=null and historical_experiments_cpe45_status='not_assessed' until ratified after independent joint 2700-s human validation.
ISS-0011 / ISS-0012 / ISS-0013: 0 open human datasets combine full 2700-s alternating load, calibrated power/velocity, spatial meters, concurrent cognition, core temperature, and post45 recovery.
anti_fitting_statement: Every threshold below is derived from external peer-reviewed physiological, biomechanical, cognitive-ergonomic, or occupational heat standards (ISO 9886, NIOSH, IOC Heat Consensus, Girard 2011, Glaister 2005, Enoka & Duchateau 2016, Sanchez-Medina 2011, Maunder 2021, Begg 2007, Schmit 2017) — NOT fitted to pass existing partial cohorts in EXP-0139..0157.

intensity_schedule.structure: 5 identical 540-s macro-blocks partitioning [0, 2700] s without gaps or overlaps

effort.prescription: Maximal all-out explosive bout (1:4 work:rest matches fast PCr resynthesis half-time ~21-30 s; Glaister 2005 SRC-0031, Girard 2011 SRC-0029)
High-submaximal sustained effort prescribed at >=80% individual Critical Power (CP) or >=75% P_VO2max (heavy-to-severe oxidative domain; Enoka & Duchateau 2016 SRC-0030)

post45_observation_times_s.mandatory_timestamp_rule: Exact individual elapsed timestamp t > 2700 s must be recorded for every post45 test; nominal labels without timestamps are inadmissible.

candidate_success_thresholds.statistical_rule: Participant-clustered 95% bootstrap CI must satisfy each channel bound (no reliance on point estimates alone).

absolute_demand_floor.external_basis: Prevents low-output pacing gaming (COMBAT_LIKE_ENDURANCE_45MIN.md L119); 5.5 kJ/kg over 2700 s (~2.04 W/kg mean across D=0.6444) reflects heavy-domain sustained output in trained adults while preserving absolute Joules & Watts alongside mass-normalized values.

mechanical_retention_late_vs_early.explosive_basis: Girard et al. 2011 (SRC-0029): >15% repeated-sprint peak power decrement indicates severe neuromuscular/metabolic breakdown.
mechanical_retention_late_vs_early.submax_basis: Maunder et al. 2021 endurance durability framework: >5-10% loss of sustainable heavy-domain power marks clinically relevant durability failure.
mechanical_retention_late_vs_early.velocity_basis: Sanchez-Medina & Gonzalez-Badillo 2011: >15-20% intraset/in-task velocity loss marks nonlinear rise in metabolic stress and fast-twitch impairment.
mechanical_retention_late_vs_early.recovery_basis: Consistent with <=10% residual decrement entering next matched bout after 24 s / 60 s recovery.

spatial_motor_control_meters.coordination_basis: Begg et al. 2007 / Barrett et al. 2010 adult minimum foot/obstacle clearance safety margin (~10-20 mm mean; >20-25% or >3 mm loss elevates trip/contact risk), corroborated by DUO-GAIT (SRC-0195).
spatial_motor_control_meters.maneuver_basis: Standardized change-of-direction / corridor path-tracking error bound; must be verified against familiarization SEM in MEASUREMENT-3.

concurrent_cognitive_control.joint_evaluation_rule: Latency evaluated on correct trials only and ALWAYS jointly with accuracy and omissions (fast errors cannot pass).
concurrent_cognitive_control.external_basis: Lambourne & Tomporowski 2010; Schmit et al. 2017 hyperthermia-cognition threshold; Enoka & Duchateau 2016 (SRC-0030).

thermoregulatory_safety_gate.external_basis: ISO 9886:2004 (38.5 C unacclimatized / 39.0 C monitored acclimatized), NIOSH 2016, and IOC Heat Consensus (Racinais et al. 2023 PMC9811094: >=39.5-40.0 C marks high exertional heat-illness and central failure risk). Tightened from EXP-0149 working_default 39.5 C so medical abort ceiling is never treated as a PASS target.

post45_recovery_vector.external_basis: Separates reversible acute metabolic fatigue (+0.5-5 min) from persistent structural/EIMD damage (+24 h; Carroll 2017, Deely 2022) and ensures short-term operational readiness (+45 min).

measurement3_minimal_protocol.design: Within-subject randomized counterbalanced crossover (2 familiarization sessions + 2 experimental sessions >=7 d apart: CPE45 intermittent D=0.6444 vs Joule-matched continuous CONT; temperate 20 C / 50% RH primary, optional warm 32 C / 50% RH arm).

sample_size.power_basis: >85% power at alpha=0.05 (two-sided) for paired dz=0.65 and +-0.4 SD 95% CI precision on retention/recovery proportions.

mandatory_hardware_sync: Calibrated power/force ergometer (>=100 Hz, signed power_W and force_N)
3D optical/IMU kinematics (>=100 Hz, hardware TTL-synced, speed_m_s, acceleration_m_s2, coordination_error_m, maneuver_error_m; max_gap_s <=1.0 s)
Concurrent standardized Go/No-Go + 2-back stimulus-response system (>=15 trials per 540-s block; explicit omitted flag, never zero-imputed)
Ingestible telemetric core-temp pill (0.1 Hz, ISO 9886 calibrated) + ECG HR + ambient WBGT
Isometric MVC + interpolated twitch (VA) + CMJ at Pre, +2 min, +5 min, +45 min, +24 h with exact timestamps t > 2700 s
measurement3_minimal_protocol.ethics_and_safety: Requires independent IRB/ethics approval, medical screening, pre-hydration verification (USG <1.020), and automatic session termination at T_core >=39.5 C or any heat-illness/musculoskeletal red flag. No human testing is performed within SUBJECT-01 computational cycles.
